recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, two-panel composition featuring a duotone photograph of a tree shadow cast against a textured stone wall, paired with a solid black vertical sidebar containing large-scale, thin-stroke vertical typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the organic, textured green-tinted photo and the flat, geometric black sidebar.
Relationship between the diagonal shadow line and the vertical orientation of the text.
Scale disparity between the massive, thin-outline display text and the small, centered secondary text.
coreInvariants: Acidic green duotone filter on the photographic element.
Solid black vertical bar occupying the right quarter of the frame.
90-degree rotated display text running vertically down the sidebar.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The photographic subject (shadow on wall) occupies the left 75% of the frame; the typography occupies the right 25% sidebar.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, diagonal shadow of the tree trunk acts as a leading line from the bottom left toward the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal shadow upward, moves across the textured wall, and then drops vertically down the large text in the sidebar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The solid black sidebar provides heavy negative space that isolates and highlights the thin-stroke lettering.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black serves as the structural frame and sidebar.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant lime/acid green provides the mid-tones for the photographic texture.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Thin gold or yellow outlines for the primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright green wall and the absolute black shadows/sidebar.

letterConstructionRules: Primary display text uses extremely thin, hairline strokes.
Secondary text uses a bold, heavy weight for maximum contrast.
Vertical orientation for the primary display text, rotated 90 degrees clockwise.

composition.relationshipToImage: Breaks the vertical flow of the display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme weight contrast: Hairline display text paired with ultra-bold, small-scale sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric 70s aesthetic and circular counters.
Provides the necessary geometric precision and thin stroke.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast photograph of a tree shadow cast onto a rustic stone brick wall. Apply a vibrant acid-green duotone filter where the bricks are green and the shadows are deep black. Add a solid black vertical bar on the right side occupying 25% of the width.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, uppercase, hairline-weight geometric sans-serif text vertically down the black sidebar using a thin gold outline. In the center of the sidebar, overlay a small block of bold white sans-serif text horizontally.

verificationChecks: Is the photographic section strictly duotone green and black?
Is the large text rotated 90 degrees clockwise?
Is there a clear weight contrast between the display and subtitle text?
Does the black sidebar have a hard, clean edge?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the shadow is dark enough to be nearly black.
Check that the hairline text is legible against the black background.
Verify the vertical text is centered within the sidebar.
Confirm the green color is saturated and 'electric' rather than natural.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Duotone Textured Photo] + [Solid Color Sidebar] + [Rotated Hairline Typography] + [Heavy Weight Subtitle Overlay].
